Same-unit conditional mean physical repair/replacement cost divided by same-unit hardware value

80×$1.05M enclosure +20×$520k PCS =$94.4M candidate hardware

Conditional scalar means with independent source/cost controls

main_logic: Wildfire is measured as FSim fire-intensity class at the unit, exact state.
Solar wildfire electrical class tables reused as judgment-based ordinal weights on FSim class, times an owner-selected consequence ($1.05M enclosure replacement, with two repair sensitivities).

Why this shape: electronics response is the simple reference for enclosed electronic/cooling/battery hardware; heavy electrical is a contrasting lower-response shape. Both are new judgment-based target transfers, not physical or probabilistic conversion of the donor DR.
The damage ratio is a share of the hardware value of the same physical unit, fixed 2024 dollars: $1.05M per integrated enclosure (80), $520,000 per PCS (20).

paragraphs: Wildfire on batteries: solar wildfire electrical class tables reused as judgment-based ordinal weights on FSim class, times an owner-selected consequence ($1.05M enclosure replacement, with two repair sensitivities). It names 2 parts: Integrated battery enclosure and Separate PCS. Outside its scope: autonomous equipment fire, collector station and export line and business interruption and performance. Kinds of damage it does not include: fire spread between units, post-fire erosion and remediation.

For this hazard the battery plant is split into 2 parts: Integrated battery enclosure and Separate PCS. 3 further units are named but withheld — bess mv and shared electrical, bess civil and bess fieldwork — a stated 'not zero', not a curve. Parts of the plant's value with no curve yet: unit MV and shared electrical, civil works and fieldwork.
$94.4M of $109.8M of the reference plant has a curve (86 %). No curve yet for unit MV and shared electrical, civil works and fieldwork (14 % of the value).
